evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and changes the RPC interface by gating getaddressinfo's iswatchonly output behind -deprecatedrpc.
rationale: Follows standard RPC deprecation discipline for an obsolete field that unconditionally returns false. The PR resolves an inconsistency where v30 release notes claimed the field was already removed while getaddressinfo still emitted it without a deprecation flag.
